cards.ex: We ran into problems with the software during the presentation.
cards.exUz: Taqdimot paytida dasturiy ta'minot bilan muammolarga duch keldik.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarga to'satdan yoki kutilmaganda duch kelish.

cards.ex: Don't worry, I'll sort it out. I'm good at fixing things.
cards.exUz: Xavotir olma, men buni hal qilaman. Men tuzatishga yaxshiman.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni yoki chalkash vaziyatni hal qilish, tartibga solish.

cards.ex: We're in a tricky situation and need to think carefully.
cards.exUz: Biz murakkab vaziyatdamiz va diqqat bilan o'ylashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hal qilish qiyin yoki noqulay vaziyat.

cards.ex: The project hit a snag when the funding was cut.
cards.exUz: Loyiha moliyalashtirish qisqarganda to'siqqa duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik kutilmagan muammo yoki kechikishga duch kelish.

cards.ex: He knew he was wrong and had to face the music.
cards.exUz: U xato qilganini bildi va javobgarlikka tortilishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolar yoki noto'g'ri harakatlar uchun oqibatlarni qabul qilish.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets worse.
cards.exUz: Bu muammo yomonlashmasdan oldin, uni ildizida yo'qotishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo rivojlanishidan oldin uni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: This is just a quick fix; we need a long-term solution.
cards.exUz: Bu faqat tez yechim; bizga uzoq muddatli yechim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni vaqtincha hal qilish, lekin asosiy sababni hal qilmaslik.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Boshidan boshlashga majbur bo'lish, avvalgi holatga qaytish.

cards.ex: I'm in a bind because I need the money but I hate the job.
cards.exUz: Men qiyin ahvoldaman, chunki menga pul kerak, lekin bu ishni yomon ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki noqulay vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The biggest pain point is the slow internet connection.
cards.exUz: Eng katta og'riqli nuqta - sekin internet aloqasi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki qiyinchilik manbai.

cards.ex: I need some time to figure out how to fix this.
cards.exUz: Buni qanday tuzatishni aniqlash uchun menga biroz vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish yoki tushunish.

cards.ex: We're on the right track to solving the problem.
cards.exUz: Biz muammoni hal qilish uchun to'g'ri yo'ldamiz.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yo'nalishda harakat qilish, muvaffaqiyatga yaqinlashish.

cards.ex: Mixing alcohol and driving is a recipe for disaster.
cards.exUz: Spirtli ichimliklarni ichish va haydash halokat retseptidir.
cards.uzDef: Yomon oqibatlarga olib kelishi aniq bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: I didn't want to work overtime, but I had to bite the bullet.
cards.exUz: Men ishdan tashqari ishlashni xohlamadim, lekin qiyinchilikka chidashim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz vaziyatni qabul qilish va chidash.

cards.ex: The business wasn't profitable, so we decided to cut our losses.
cards.exUz: Biznes foydali emas edi, shuning uchun zararni kamaytirishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatsiz holatni to'xtatish va ko'proq zarar ko'rmaslik.

cards.ex: We need to get to the bottom of why this happened.
cards.exUz: Nima uchun bu sodir bo'lganligini aniqlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning asosiy sababini aniqlash.

cards.ex: Taxes are a necessary evil for funding public services.
cards.exUz: Soliqlar davlat xizmatlarini moliyalashtirish uchun zarur yomonlikdir.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz, lekin maqsadga erishish uchun zarur bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: I felt stuck in a rut at my old job.
cards.exUz: Men eski ishimda bir xillikda qolib ketgandek his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Qiziqarli bo'lmagan, bir xil hayot tarzida qolib ketish.

cards.ex: Choosing to sell the company was the lesser of two evils.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyani sotish ikki yomondan yengili edi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki yomon variantdan kamroq yomon bo'lganini tanlash.

cards.ex: I decided to take the plunge and start my own business.
cards.exUz: Men tavakkal qilishga va o'z biznesimni boshlashga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli qaror qabul qilish.

cards.ex: We're not out of the woods yet, but things are improving.
cards.exUz: Biz hali xavfdan xalos bo'lmadik, lekin vaziyat yaxshilanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan chiqish, xavfdan xalos bo'lish.

cards.ex: Poverty can create a vicious cycle of poor education and unemployment.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlik yomon ta'lim va ishsizlikning yopiq doirasini yaratishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'zini o'zi qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yomon holat.

cards.ex: You need to face up to your responsibilities.
cards.exUz: Siz o'z mas'uliyatingizni qabul qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyat yoki muammoni qabul qilish va hal qilishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The salary was the main sticking point in the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralarda maosh asosiy munozarali nuqta edi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvga erishishga to'sqinlik qiladigan asosiy muammo.

cards.ex: He learned the hard way not to trust strangers.
cards.exUz: U begonalarga ishonmaslikni achchiq saboq orqali o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolar qilib, tajriba orqali saboq olmoq.

cards.ex: The party got out of hand and the neighbors complained.
cards.exUz: Kechasi nazoratdan chiqib ketdi va qo'shnilar shikoyat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat nazoratdan chiqib ketmoq.

cards.ex: The new strategy helped to turn the tide of the company's fortunes.
cards.exUz: Yangi strategiya kompaniya taqdirini o'zgartirishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning yo'nalishini o'zgartirish, muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: Technology is a double-edged sword; it can help or harm.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya ikki tomonlama qilichdir; u yordam berishi ham, zarar etkazishi ham mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi va yomon tomonlari bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Missing one deadline can be a slippery slope to failing the whole project.
cards.exUz: Bir muddatni o'tkazib yuborish butun loyihaning muvaffaqiyatsizligiga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan sirpanchiq yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kichik xato yoki qaror katta muammolarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: We need to nip this conflict in the bud before it escalates.
cards.exUz: Biz bu mojaroo kuchaymasdan oldin uning oldini olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo kuchaymasdan oldin uning oldini olish.
